summary.text: CVE-2024-3400 is a critical command‑injection vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN‑OS GlobalProtect that allows unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges; it is listed in the CISA KEV catalog as a known exploited vulnerability and has an EPSS score of 0.99999 indicating a very high likelihood of exploitation in the next 30 days.

findings.rationale: The CVE record (E001) describes a network‑vector, unauthenticated command injection with a CVSS 3.1 base score of 10.0 (critical). The CISA KEV catalog (E002) confirms the vulnerability is actively exploited and associated with known ransomware campaigns, and provides a required action to apply vendor mitigations. The EPSS model (E003) assigns a score of 0.99999, indicating a very high probability of exploitation in the near term.
recommended_actions: Apply the vendor‑provided mitigations (e.g., Threat Prevention IDs) as described in the CISA KEV entry.
Monitor Palo Alto Networks advisories for a patch release and plan to upgrade affected PAN‑OS versions promptly.
Inventory PAN‑OS devices to determine whether any are running the affected versions (10.2.0‑10.2.9‑h1, 11.0.0‑11.0.4‑h1, 11.1.0‑11.1.2‑h3) and prioritize remediation for those assets.
uncertainties: The investigation lacks asset‑specific context; it is unknown whether the organization runs any of the affected PAN‑OS versions.
No fixed version is listed in the CVE record; the exact patch release timeline is not known.

descriptions:
A command injection as a result of arbitrary file creation vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software for specific PAN-OS versions and distinct feature configurations may enable an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

Cloud NGFW, Panorama appliances, and Prisma Access are not impacted by this vulnerability.

entry.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
entry.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect feature contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands with root privileges on the firewall.
entry.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions as they become available. Otherwise, users with vulnerable versions of affected devices should enable Threat Prevention IDs available from the vendor. See the vendor bulletin for more details and a patch release schedule.
